title: Osanwe structured prediction object (v1)
description: The machine-readable contract every quantitative prediction MUST satisfy before it may be recorded, backtested, or acted on. Replaces vague BUY/SELL labels: a prediction is a full return DISTRIBUTION against a named benchmark over a stated horizon, with explicit uncertainty, costs, capacity, and invalidation terms. Consumers: tools/backtest-prediction.py, tools/calibrate-confidence.py (confidence-map.json bins), tools/pretrade_gate.py.

instrument_id.description: Ticker of the instrument the prediction is about, upper-case canonical form (e.g. AAPL, BRK.B).

prediction_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp WITH timezone offset when the prediction was issued.

information_cutoff.description: Last timestamp of data actually used to produce this prediction. MUST NOT be later than prediction_timestamp; anything after it is lookahead leakage.

horizon_days.description: Trading-day horizon of the prediction (e.g. 21 = one month, 63 = one quarter).

target_variable.description: What is being predicted. v1 fixes this to annualized excess total return vs benchmark_id.

benchmark_id.description: Benchmark ticker excess return is measured against (e.g. SPY).

expected_return.description: Point estimate of ANNUALIZED expected excess return over the horizon, as a decimal fraction (-2.0 .. +2.0 i.e. -200%..+200%).

skew.description: Skewness of the predicted excess-return distribution.

kurtosis.description: Excess kurtosis of the predicted excess-return distribution.

probability_positive_excess.description: Model probability that realized excess return over the horizon is > 0.

expected_volatility.description: Annualized expected volatility of EXCESS returns (decimal; 0.30 = 30%).

expected_max_drawdown_pct.description: Expected maximum drawdown of the position over the horizon, in PERCENT (positive number, e.g. 18.5).

var_95_daily.description: 95% one-day Value at Risk in DOLLARS for the intended position size. Positive number; loss magnitude.

lower.description: Lower bound of annualized excess return (decimal).

upper.description: Upper bound of annualized excess return (decimal); must be >= lower.

level.description: Coverage level, e.g. 0.8 for an 80% interval.

calibration_bin.description: Stated-confidence bin this prediction's probability_positive_excess maps to in wiki/maintenance/calibration/confidence-map.json (e.g. '70-79'). Downstream graders read the CALIBRATED value from the map, not the raw number.

signal_components.description: Named factor contributions, each a z-like score in [-10, 10], e.g. {"momentum": 1.4, "quality": -0.3}. At least one component required so attribution is possible.

model_version.description: Version identifier of the generating model/process (e.g. 'invest-v2.3').

dataset_version.description: Version/snapshot id of the input dataset used (must be reproducible from registry).

invalidation_conditions.description: Concrete, checkable events that void the prediction before expiration (e.g. 'guidance cut > 5%', 'benchmark regime flip to backwardation'). At least one required.

expiration_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp WITH timezone offset after which the prediction is dead regardless of outcome. Must be strictly after prediction_timestamp.

min_action.description: Lower bound of recommended action, PERCENT of current position to change (-100 = exit long, +100 = double). Negative = trim/short.

max_action.description: Upper bound of recommended action, same units. Must be >= min_action. A RANGE, never a single point.

assumed_cost_bps.description: Round-trip transaction cost assumed in basis points when forming net expectations.

capacity_estimate_usd.description: Estimated capital capacity for the trade in USD before market impact degrades the edge beyond assumed_cost_bps.

liquidity_score.description: Subjective 1-10 liquidity score of the instrument (10 = deepest).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 with explicit timezone offset (Z or +HH:MM). Naive timestamps are invalid.
